confidence_note: the storage and transfer figures are a first-party page, and they are the fields the verdict rests on. The anonymous token and manifest probes prove the read path, which does not raise a documented quota. The earlier anonymous-pull measurement used library/hello-world, a Docker Hub namespace rather than a ghcr.io one, so it proved nothing about a public ghcr.io package.
